name: שברים חלקיים – שני גורמים לינאריים (באנגלית, א)
questiontext:
By expressing the integrand as the sum of its partial fractions, find the following integral:

\[ \int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}}. \]

[[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Write the integrand as a sum of partial fractions, find the coefficients, and then integrate term by term.
Step 1 — The form of the decomposition
In order to calculate

\[ \int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}} \]

we need to express

\[ {{CT:0}} \]

as the sum of its partial fractions.
Partial fractions: \( \frac{p(x)}{(x-a)(x-b)}=\frac{A}{x-a}+\frac{B}{x-b} \); a repeated factor \( (x-a)^2 \) gives \( \frac{A}{x-a}+\frac{B}{(x-a)^2} \); an irreducible \( x^2+bx+c \) gives \( \frac{Ax+B}{x^2+bx+c} \)

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle {{CT:0}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:2}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:3}}{{CT:4}} + {{CT:5}}{{CT:6}} \end{array} \]

Step 2 — Finding the coefficients
By multiplying both sides by \({{CT:7}}\) we get

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle {{CT:8}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:9}}+{{CT:10}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:11}} \end{array} \]

Equating coefficients of \({{CT:1}}\) we get a system of equations that can be solved to get \(A = {{CT:12}}\) and \(B = {{CT:13}}\). So,

\[ {{CT:0}} = {{CT:14}} \]

Step 3 — Integrating term by term
Hence,

\[ \begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle \int {{CT:0}} d{{CT:1}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \int {{CT:14}} d{{CT:1}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:12}} \int {{CT:4}} d{{CT:1}} + {{CT:13}} \int {{CT:6}} d{{CT:1}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:15}} + {{CT:16}} +c \end{array} \]
